## Grape

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/beri_grape.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active · Transformation*

The user splits their body into lots of berry balls, the balls move aside from every hit by hand or with a weapon, even blades and Armament Haki, but each dodge makes the split end sooner They rise up to 5 blocks over the ground while jump is held, crouching takes them down, and they fall slowly All the parts of the body must be back to split, while split the other abilities take their balls out of the bunch and they come back to it The balls stay bunched. The user can still hit with their fists The balls scatter. Arrows and shots miss too, but the user can't attack

## Swarm

![](../../assets/playable/inomissing/abilities/beri_swarm.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user sends berry balls of their body around the enemy they look at, the balls circle it and charge it from every side one after the other The balls are both arms and both legs, they fly back to the user after and must all be back to use it again

## Berry Rain
